confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from travel-guide and cost-of-living sources dated 2025-2026. These sources are mixed in method and several are affiliate or blog estimates, so treat them as rough. Peak-season (July) uplift of about 20-30% on restaurant prices is applied. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context only; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Converted at roughly 1.10 USD per EUR, derived from the RBA AUD rate and a cross-rate, so the EUR-to-USD step is approximate. The FX observation is the most recent RBA 4pm rate found (18 Nov 2026), not the 19 Nov fix, which was not located.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Adriatic Croatian coastal tourism centres and mid-sized Southern European seaside cities in peak season. Split's Riva and old-town venues are weighted toward tourist pricing, with cheaper konoba and bakery options for the inexpensive tier.
